item.title: Beyond the Trilogy: Franchise Longevity & Scream 7
item.description: Tony and Brady discuss the challenges of continuing a movie franchise beyond three films, and review Brady's take on "Scream 7" and other post-trilogy franchises like James Bond, John Wick, Toy Story and Star Wars.

item.title: Crash between truck and tractor-trailer kills 20-year-old man in McDonald County
item.description: A 20-year-old man from Stella, Missouri, was killed in a crash five miles north of Pineville on Wednesday morning when his pickup truck collided with a tractor-trailer.

item.title: Gearing up for the next wave of storms and severe weather Friday night
item.description: Warm and windy weather will mark the end of the workweek, with scattered storms and a squall line bringing the potential for severe weather Friday night, followed by cooler temperatures and sunny skies on Saturday.
